# Wyatt Au — Backend Engineer & Systems Architect

> Personal site and intelligence dashboard of Wyatt Au: deterministic
> infrastructure, high-performance systems, and client-side quantitative
> analysis. Includes live market data (ETFs, crypto, macro indicators),
> 16 interactive Rust/WASM widgets, and an ML benchmark explorer. All
> computation runs client-side in the browser.

## Pages

- [Home](https://wyattau.com/): overview of Wyatt Au — backend engineering, systems architecture, and current work bootstrapping QuestHive.
- [World Monitor](https://wyattau.com/world): real-time intelligence dashboard — crypto prices via Binance WebSocket, world map with live ISS position, macro rates (VIX, DXY, yields), earthquakes, GOES X-ray solar activity, planetary K-index with 3-day geomagnetic forecast, Bitcoin fee market, and upcoming orbital launches.
- [ETF Intelligence](https://wyattau.com/etf): database of 89 ETFs with allocation analysis, correlation matrix, Monte Carlo simulation, VaR, portfolio backtesting, and walk-forward analysis.
- [ML Benchmarks](https://wyattau.com/ml): LLM benchmark leaderboards, model comparison radar charts, GPU requirement calculator, and inference throughput simulator.
- [World Data](https://wyattau.com/data/etf-database.json): reference datasets powering the dashboards — JSON under `/data/` (etf-database, seo-audit, seo-pages).
- [Docs](https://wyattau.com/docs): technical notes, architecture decisions, and infrastructure documentation.
- [Dossier](https://wyattau.com/dossier): detailed biography and timeline.
- [Projects](https://wyattau.com/projects): selected engineering projects.
- [Guestbook](https://wyattau.com/guestbook): visitor messages, persisted in Cloudflare KV.

## Highlights

- All client-side computation is Rust compiled to WebAssembly (lock-free ring buffers, binary serialization, SIMD-optimized numerics) — roughly 140 KB across 16 widgets.
- Charts render via [plychart](https://github.com/WyattAu/plychart), a custom Rust/WASM charting library with pan and zoom.
- The stack is Astro 5 + SolidJS 1.9 + Tailwind CSS 4, deployed on Cloudflare Pages and Workers.

## Machine-readable access

- Markdown variants of key pages (for AI citation): [/markdown/index.md](https://wyattau.com/markdown/index.md), [/markdown/world.md](https://wyattau.com/markdown/world.md), [/markdown/etf.md](https://wyattau.com/markdown/etf.md), [/markdown/ml.md](https://wyattau.com/markdown/ml.md), [/markdown/dossier.md](https://wyattau.com/markdown/dossier.md), [/markdown/projects.md](https://wyattau.com/markdown/projects.md) — advertised per-page via `Link: ...; rel="alternate"; type="text/markdown"` headers.
- Agent discovery: [/.well-known/api-catalog](https://wyattau.com/.well-known/api-catalog) (RFC 9727), [/.well-known/agent-card.json](https://wyattau.com/.well-known/agent-card.json) (A2A), [/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json](https://wyattau.com/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json), [/auth.md](https://wyattau.com/auth.md), [/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource](https://wyattau.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource) (RFC 9728; no auth required).
- Keyless JSON APIs (edge-cached, GET, no auth): `/api/crypto-ticker`, `/api/earthquakes`, `/api/kp-index`, `/api/aurora?lat=&lon=`, `/api/aurora-history`, `/api/swpc-alerts`, `/api/space-launches`, `/api/fear-greed`, `/api/stock-quote`, `/api/mempool`, `/api/health`, plus market/FX/reference endpoints. See [/auth.md](https://wyattau.com/auth.md) for the full list and etiquette.

# Page: ETF Intelligence (https://wyattau.com/etf)

# ETF Intelligence — database and analysis

ETF database with 89 ETFs: allocation analysis, portfolio comparison,
correlation matrix, Monte Carlo simulation, VaR, portfolio backtesting,
and walk-forward analysis.

## What can I analyze on the ETF page?

- Search and compare 89 ETFs by asset class and provider.
- Allocation breakdown and correlation matrices.
- Monte Carlo simulation and Value-at-Risk (VaR) for portfolio construction.
- Walk-forward backtesting of allocation strategies.
- Efficient frontier and HRP allocation demos.

All quantitative computation runs client-side in Rust/WebAssembly — no
server round-trips, no data leaves the browser.

## Frequently asked questions

**How many ETFs are in the database?** 89 ETFs with allocation analysis, correlation matrices, Monte Carlo simulation, VaR, portfolio backtesting, and walk-forward analysis.

**Does the ETF analysis send my data anywhere?** No. All quantitative computation runs client-side in Rust compiled to WebAssembly — no server round-trips, no data leaves the browser.

**What can I backtest?** Allocation strategies with walk-forward analysis, Monte Carlo forecast paths, drawdown profiles, and risk/return scatter against the selected benchmark.

# Page: Home (https://wyattau.com/)

# Wyatt Au — Backend Engineer & Systems Architect

Personal intelligence dashboard and portfolio site of Wyatt Au: real-time
market data, OSINT feeds, 16 Rust/WASM quantitative widgets, and an
interactive guestbook. All computation is client-side WebAssembly; public
data APIs are keyless and edge-cached.

## What is on this site?

- [World Monitor](https://wyattau.com/world) — real-time intelligence
  dashboard: crypto prices via Binance WebSocket, world map with capital
  markets and ISS position, macro rates (VIX, DXY, yields, gold), earthquakes,
  solar-wind telemetry, and upcoming orbital launches.
- [ETF Intelligence](https://wyattau.com/etf) — database of 89 ETFs with
  allocation analysis, correlation matrix, Monte Carlo simulation, VaR,
  portfolio backtesting, and walk-forward analysis.
- [ML Benchmarks](https://wyattau.com/ml) — LLM benchmark leaderboards,
  model comparison radar charts, GPU requirement calculator, and inference
  throughput simulator.
- [WASM Showcase](https://wyattau.com/#wasm-showcase) — 16 interactive
  Rust/WASM demonstrations: Monte Carlo simulation, SVI volatility surface,
  Fourier analysis, cellular automata, physics sandbox, generative art.
- [Docs](https://wyattau.com/docs) — technical notes and architecture
  decisions.
- [Dossier](https://wyattau.com/dossier) — detailed biography and timeline.
- [Projects](https://wyattau.com/projects) — selected engineering projects.

## Live data APIs (keyless, no auth)

All data endpoints are public GET, edge-cached, and return JSON:

- `GET /api/crypto-ticker` — Binance 24h USDT mini-tickers.
- `GET /api/earthquakes` — USGS all-day earthquake feed (GeoJSON).
- `GET /api/kp-index` — NOAA planetary K-index.
- `GET /api/space-launches` — upcoming orbital launches (Launch Library 2).
- `GET /api/fear-greed` — crypto Fear & Greed index.
- `GET /api/stock-quote?symbols=^VIX,DX-Y.NYB` — Yahoo Finance quotes.

Poll at most once per cache window (60 s–30 min). Identify yourself with a
User-Agent header. Full machine-readable discovery:
`/.well-known/api-catalog` (RFC 9727), `/.well-known/agent-card.json` (A2A),
and `/auth.md`.

## About Wyatt Au

Wyatt Au builds deterministic infrastructure and high-performance systems.
Currently bootstrapping QuestHive. Based in the United Kingdom.

# Page: ML Intelligence (https://wyattau.com/ml)

# ML Intelligence — LLM benchmarks and tools

LLM benchmark leaderboards, model comparison radar charts, ArXiv paper
feeds, GPU requirement calculator, and inference throughput simulator for
AI and machine learning engineers.

## What can I do on the ML Intelligence page?

- Compare LLM benchmark leaderboards across providers and tasks.
- Overlay models on comparison radar charts.
- Read recent ArXiv paper feeds relevant to ML engineering.
- Estimate GPU requirements for serving a model at a target context and
  batch size.
- Simulate inference throughput (tokens/s) across hardware profiles.

All quantitative computation runs client-side in Rust/WebAssembly — no
server round-trips, no data collection.

## Frequently asked questions

**What does the GPU requirement calculator cover?** Serving estimates across hardware profiles for a target model context and batch size — VRAM, parameter counts, and quantization tradeoffs.

**Where do the LLM benchmarks come from?** Publicly reported benchmark scores aggregated into leaderboards with model comparison radar charts, served via the site Worker API.

**Is the throughput simulator real inference?** No — it is a client-side WebAssembly simulation of inference throughput across hardware profiles, not live model serving.

# Projects — Wyatt Au

Open-source projects and technical work by Wyatt Au: Rust crates, WASM
quantitative widgets, MCP servers, and the intelligence dashboard you are
reading.

## What projects are featured?

- **plychart** — custom Rust/WASM charting library with pan and zoom
  powering every chart on this site.
- **estate crates** — webhookkit (idempotent webhooks), throttle-kit
  (rate limiting), otelkit (OpenTelemetry composition) and more,
  published on crates.io.
- **MCP servers** — native Rust implementations (GitHub, filesystem,
  web search, memory) used across the development estate.
- **hydrated personal site** — Astro 5 + SolidJS 1.9 + Rust/WASM
  intelligence dashboard, deployed on Cloudflare Pages and Workers.

Full inventory: [GitHub](https://github.com/WyattAu) and
[Forgejo](https://forgejo.wyattau.com/wyatt_admin).

# Page: World Monitor (https://wyattau.com/world)

# World Monitor — intelligence dashboard

Real-time intelligence dashboard of Wyatt Au: crypto prices via Binance
WebSocket, world map with ISS position, macro rates (VIX, DXY, 10Y yield,
gold), earthquakes, solar-wind telemetry, and upcoming orbital launches.

## What data does World Monitor show?

- Live crypto prices (BTC, ETH, SOL, BNB, XRP, ADA) from Binance WebSocket,
  24h change and high/low.
- World map with ISS live position (wheretheiss.at, 5 s polling) and
  capital-city markers.
- Macro rates: VIX, DXY, US 10Y yield, gold, silver, copper, WTI, Brent —
  from Yahoo Finance.
- Bitcoin structure: market cap estimate, 24h volume, funding rate, open
  interest, long/short ratio, NVT.
- Sentiment: Fear & Greed index, Kp geomagnetic index.
- Upcoming orbital launches from Launch Library 2.

## Data sources

All data is fetched client-side from keyless public APIs (Binance, Yahoo
Finance, USGS, NOAA SWPC, Launch Library 2, wheretheiss.at) and edge-cached
by the site's Workers API. No API keys, no authentication.
